_README: GCC cross-market evaluation set for the Bahrain Bourse corpus. Schema mirrors data/financebench/matched_questions.json so the same evaluation harness can run on it. All 35 gold answers were verified by hand against the source PDFs: each numeric figure was confirmed to exist in extractable PDF text and the correct year-column was visually checked. Answers cite BHD/USD only where that currency appears in extractable text (NBB USD columns sit on image-only pages and are therefore not cited). Companies map to data/bahrain_bourse/{company}/ and to tickers in config.BAHRAIN_BOURSE_COMPANIES.
_status: 35 questions, ALL 35 verified against source PDFs (figures confirmed in extractable text + year-column headers checked).
